comment: AutF is a prenyltransferase from the autumnalamide biosynthetic pathway

reactions.description: AutF catalyses prenylation to nitrogen of the guanidinium moiety in arginine to yield autumnalamide A
AutF prenylates the guanidine moiety in arginine and homoarginine. The enzyme also demonstrates a preference for linear l-Arg containing precursors over cyclic variants of autumnalamide A

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
